question: What is the total quantity sold per product?

columns.name: total_qty_sold
columns.description: Total quantity sold (units or kg). Use floats for kg; round to 2 decimals if fractional.

notes: Return one row per product (all products if include_all_products=true).

question: What is the total revenue per product?

columns.name: total_revenue
columns.description: Total revenue from this product in same currency as transcript (round to 2 decimals).

question: What is the total quantity bought by each customer?

columns.name: total_qty
columns.description: Total quantity bought by that customer (sum of units and kg as recorded).

notes: Return rows for every customer who appears in the transcript.

question: How much did each customer spend?

columns.name: total_spent
columns.description: Total money spent by customer; round to 2 decimals.

notes: Return rows for every customer who appears in the transcript.

question: Which 5 products had the highest revenue?
notes: Ties may be broken arbitrarily but must preserve rank order starting at 1.

question: Which 5 products had the highest quantity sold?

columns.name: qty_sold
columns.description: Total qty sold; round to 2 decimals

question: What is the total revenue across all products?

columns.name: total_revenue
columns.description: Single-row table with total revenue (round to 2 decimals)

notes: Return a single row with the scalar.

question: What is the total number of units (or kg) sold across all products?

columns.name: total_qty_all
columns.description: Scalar sum of all quantities (units and kg as recorded). Round to 2 decimals.

question: What is the total revenue per category?

columns.name: revenue
columns.description: Total revenue for that category; round to 2 decimals

notes: Return one row per category present in the catalog.

question: What is the average order value per customer?

columns.name: average_order_value
columns.description: Average revenue per order for that customer; round to 2 decimals

notes: Include customers who had at least one order.
